machines.detail: All 9 petroleum-processing machines are implemented: distillery(T17), centrifuge(T16/T17), mixer(T16), smelter(T17), compressor(T16), electrolyzer(T17), fuels_engine(T18), fuels_gas(T18), generifier(T11). No new machine Kind/Tier needed.

energy.detail: Energy identities are explicit per family: distillery/smelter=HU, centrifuge/mixer/electrolyzer/generifier=EU, compressor=KU, fuels_engine=KU(producer), fuels_gas=HU(producer). No energy folding. Compressor KU/ELECTRIC mismatch is a known T16 audit item, not a B1 blocker.

ordinary_optional_unregistered: soulsandoil (no CC identity — not in gt6_oredict_fluids_normalized)
liquid_medium_oil (no CC identity — row 872 published via T11 as crude_oil path)
fluids.b1_deferred_decision: The 5 ordinary_optional fluids are deferred to post-1.0 portfolio. Each has owner(T22 B1), replacement_condition(fluid identity registration per T11 source-backed route), and recheck_point(post-1.0 fluid audit). Registering them now would add 5 new CC fluid identities for 5 optional rows — not justified for Beta where the core crude_oil chain suffices.

containers.detail: T10 cell/portable罐 allowlist covers fluid containment. T11 cell_content_gate already includes natural_gas. Other petroleum fluids are cell-compatible via the T10 generic fluid cell mechanism.

localization.en_us: crude_oil, natural_gas, lubricant, oil_sand, oil_shale, petroleum_coke have both fluid_type and material keys. oil/fuel/methane are internal materials (not player-facing items).
localization.zh_cn: crude_oil(原油), natural_gas(天然气) confirmed. Coverage not regressed from T21 baseline.
localization.models: Petroleum fluids use generated/placeholder fluid textures via the standard fluid rendering pipeline. No custom item/block models needed for fluids.

acquisition.crude_oil: T9 identity, T20 worldgen subsurface fluid deposit, extracted via pump
acquisition.natural_gas: T9 identity, T20 worldgen subsurface fluid deposit, extracted via pump
acquisition.oil_sand: T20 worldgen large vein, mined as ore
acquisition.oil_shale: T20 worldgen large vein, mined as ore
acquisition.acquisition_proof: T18 GameTest: crude_oil extraction → fuel_engine → dynamo → electrolyzer chain verifies operand reachability

t21_cascade_risk.reason: No new material or fluid registrations are added in B1. The v1 petroleum fluids were all registered in T9/T11/T20. Unlike T21 which added new chemical materials triggering ~50 downstream product rebuilds, B1 adds zero new identities — thus zero cascade risk.
t21_cascade_risk.rebuild_note: Full rebuild (58 builders) requires GT6 dump which is not in worktree. Without new registrations, rebuild would produce zero diffs — not worth the overhead.
